newsitem.title: USA: JAL 19 PCT DROP IN JULY JFK CARGO IMPORTS.
newsitem.headline: JAL 19 PCT DROP IN JULY JFK CARGO IMPORTS.

text.p: Japan Airlines Co Ltd exported 1,115 tonnes of cargo from John F. Kennedy airport in July, up 9.7 percent from 1,016 tonnes in the same 1996 month, , JAL cargo sales manager at JFK, Yoshio Atsumi, told Reuters.
Imports reached 1,200 tonnes in July, down 19.3 percent from 1,487 tonnes a year earlier, Atsumi added.
Atsumi attributed the decrease of inbound volume partly to a "seasonal slowdown" and perhaps increased competition.
He said: "it's not usually this slow (in July). Added competition from Polar and United Airlines something to do with it."
Both Polar Air Cargo and United operated weekly round trip services between JFK and Osaka.
In the fiscal year to end-March, JAL exported 25,768 tonnes (22,027 tonnes in 95/96)from JFK and imported 15,976 tonnes (14,584 tonnes).
Electronics, seafood, computer parts, and apparel headed the carrier's list of most commonly moved inbound and outbound cargo during July, little changed on 12 months previously.
The carrier operates six weekly round-trip Boeing 747-freighter flights between JFK and Tokyo. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
